decisions.similarity: a similarity is null (no score computed) or finite; never NaN and never 0 used as a fake score
decisions.confidence: when the ranking is non-discriminative the handler publishes no numeric confidence
decisions.coverage: comparableEmbeddings counts only the query model's space and equals the rows actually scanned when the scan is not capped
decisions.bounds: every route's wire answer carries [bounds: returned/totalMatches/truncated]
decisions.pageSize: 0 and >100 are refused with the page-size sentence at the handler and at the engine, never clamped
decisions.readOnly: a vector answer and an aggregate answer leave brain.db and its WAL byte-identical; a missing index is not created

limitations: The lexical-fallback leg's read-only status depends on shared engines outside this lane; when they still open read-write the check passes only with those files named as a blocked-on-bb_search leg (reported in the result detail and the lane evidence).
